dedupe_keys.name: rotated horizontal to vertical spectral ratios on earthquake hvsr rot recordings of stations of the 6n network during the activities of the emersito ingv emergency group in ancona italy following the 2022 mw 5 5 costa marchigiana pesarese earthquake

description: Italy’s Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia publishes directional horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios calculated from earthquake recordings in Ancona. The temporary 6N network monitored the sequence following the November 2022 magnitude-5.5 Adriatic earthquake. Rotating the horizontal components produces station tables indexed by frequency and angle, with a mean spectral ratio in the third column. Zenodo provides these comma-separated text files openly and free under CC-BY-4.0. They describe relative spectral behaviour, not complete accelerograms or observed building damage. Event selection, wave approach and local geology create uncertainty when extrapolating to stronger shaking. The tables can inform orientation-sensitive site-response assumptions in seismic simulations of urban structures. They complement rotated ambient-noise ratios with results based on actual earthquake signals. The source archive and other spectral products remain separately identified; the model inputs were not generated or validated during this review. Coverage is limited to Ancona.
name: Rotated horizontal to vertical spectral ratios on earthquake (HVSR rot) recordings of stations of the 6N network during the activities of the EMERSITO INGV emergency group in Ancona (Italy) following the 2022 MW 5.5 Costa Marchigiana-Pesarese earthquake
